title: 5 products & a card; only for “hip” mom’s; pricey for what’s inside
text:
5 products & a card; only for “hip” mom’s; pricey for what’s inside. [[VIDEOID:ebf2c8a8737f9527128aae6b5b9f5607]] In this set is:

- one "You got this Mom" card with blank interior that says "

- one pair of mediocre quality pink bed socks wrapped up like a cupcake

- one lackluster and almost scentless bath bomb; performance is good; fragrance is blah and almost non-existent; suds last 12 minutes; finish is clear apricot/peach-colored water

- one almost scentless almond coconut soap that smells a bit like something but it is certainly neither almond or coconut

- one large natural soy wax candle that smells awful; has a saying on front that says "MOM life is hard but at least your children aren't ugly."

- one small natural soy wax candle that actually smells nice and floral; has a saying on front that says "Mom's last nerve Oh look...it's on fire."

After having tried the bath bomb and socks and smelled and fiddled with the three other items, I do not feel this is worth the $34.99 price which would come to $7 per item (not counting the card). Also, not every mom would love the verses on both candles or be accepting of a "You got this Mom" message on a card front. Presentation is excellent but the products are lackluster and the price is too much.
